name: Divination
text: Uses (6 charges). [action]: Investigate. For this investigation, you may use [willpower] instead of [intellect], and you get +2 skill value. If you succeed, spend 1, 2, or 3 charges. Instead of discovering a clue at your location, discover 1 clue at your location for each charge spent. If you succeed by 0, choose and discard 2 cards from your hand.
text_cn: 使用(6充能)。 [action]：调查。这次调查你可以不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]，并且你+2技能值。如果你成功，花费1、2或3充能。不发现你所在地点的一个线索，改为每花费1充能，发现你所在地点的1个线索。如果你成功且等于难度，从你手牌中选择并丢弃2张卡牌。
